_about: Embraer 190, from APM 1901 Rev 21 (May 27/22) Figure 2.1 General Aircraft Dimensions (page index 17): side, plan and front views on one sheet, black vector lines. The figure is stretched lengthwise by about 10% in all three views: each is rendered with --xscale 0.911, which brings its printed 36.24 m length and 28.72 m span to the scale of its printed heights (10.57 m above the drawn ground line, and Figure 2.5's 3.35 m fuselage). Pixels of layers.py rasters at scale 16, line centres. Two windows behind the winglet's lines are placed at the drawing's pitch.

sources.title: Embraer, Embraer 190 Airport Planning Manual (APM 1901 Rev 21, May 27/22), Section 02, Figure 2.1 General Aircraft Dimensions; Figure 2.5 cabin cross-section
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/e190/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The figure is stretched lengthwise by about 10% and is evened out from its printed figures, so confidence is medium. Embraer's APM link now goes nowhere; read from the copy downloaded for round 1 (the same as the Internet Archive's).
